'''Cabala of Saboth''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 2 [[movement]] points to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-2) check]].  If you pass, draw 1 [[Skill]] and discard Cabala of Saboth. If you fail, nothing happens.

'''Price''': $5

==Mythos Source==

The Cabala of Saboth first appeared in ''The Secret in the Tomb'', written by Robert Bloch.
